import java.util.*;

public class Solver {
    static final int MAXT = 65;
    static final int MAXC = 12;
    static final int MAXN = 25;
    static final int INF = 10007;

    int n, k;
    String[] S, T;
    int[][] distToZ;
    int[][][][][] dp;
    int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    List<int[]> src, snk;

    class PushRelabelFIFO {
        class Edge {
            int from, to, cap, flow;
            Edge(int from, int to, int cap) {
                this.from = from;
                this.to = to;
                this.cap = cap;
                this.flow = 0;
            }
        }
        int n;
        List<Edge> edges;
        List<List<Integer>> adj;
        int[] h, excess, inq;
        Queue<Integer> q;

        PushRelabelFIFO(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            edges = new ArrayList<>();
            adj = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            h = new int[n];
            excess = new int[n];
            inq = new int[n];
            q = new LinkedList<>();
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
            adj.get(u).add(edges.size());
            edges.add(new Edge(u, v, cap));
            adj.get(v).add(edges.size());
            edges.add(new Edge(v, u, 0));
        }

        void enqueue(int u) {
            if (inq[u] == 0 && excess[u] > 0) {
                q.add(u);
                inq[u] = 1;
            }
        }

        void push(int id) {
            Edge e = edges.get(id);
            int d = Math.min(e.cap - e.flow, excess[e.from]);
            if (d > 0 && h[e.from] == h[e.to] + 1) {
                e.flow += d;
                excess[e.to] += d;
                excess[e.from] -= d;
                edges.get(id ^ 1).flow -= d;
                enqueue(e.to);
            }
        }

        void relabel(int u) {
            int minH = 2 * n;
            for (int id : adj.get(u)) {
                Edge e = edges.get(id);
                if (e.cap > e.flow) minH = Math.min(minH, h[e.to]);
            }
            h[u] = minH + 1;
        }

        void discharge(int u) {
            while (excess[u] > 0) {
                boolean pushed = false;
                for (int id : adj.get(u)) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(id);
                    if (e.cap > e.flow && h[u] == h[e.to] + 1) {
                        push(id);
                        pushed = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!pushed) relabel(u);
            }
        }

        int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            h[s] = n;
            inq[s] = 1;
            inq[t] = 1;
            for (int id : adj.get(s)) {
                Edge e = edges.get(id);
                if (e.cap > 0) {
                    int d = e.cap;
                    e.flow += d;
                    edges.get(id ^ 1).flow -= d;
                    excess[e.to] += d;
                    excess[s] -= d;
                    enqueue(e.to);
                }
            }
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                inq[u] = 0;
                discharge(u);
                if (excess[u] > 0) enqueue(u);
            }
            return excess[t];
        }
    }

    void readInput() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        S = new String[n];
        T = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) S[i] = sc.next();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) T[i] = sc.next();
        dp = new int[MAXT][MAXC][MAXC][MAXC][MAXC];
        for (int a = 0; a < MAXT; a++)
            for (int b = 0; b < MAXC; b++)
                for (int c = 0; c < MAXC; c++)
                    for (int d = 0; d < MAXC; d++)
                        Arrays.fill(dp[a][b][c][d], -1);
        sc.close();
    }

    void bfsFromZ(int sx, int sy) {
        distToZ = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(distToZ[i], -1);
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        distToZ[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dx[d];
                int ny = y + dy[d];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= n || ny < 0 || ny >= n) continue;
                if (distToZ[nx][ny] != -1) continue;
                if (T[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Y' || T[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Z') continue;
                distToZ[nx][ny] = distToZ[x][y] + 1;
                q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
            }
        }
    }

    int canReach(int t, int x0, int y0, int x, int y) {
        if (distToZ[x0][y0] < t) return 0;
        if (x0 == x && y0 == y) return 1;
        if (t >= k) return 0;
        if (distToZ[x0][y0] <= t) return 0;
        if (dp[t][x0][y0][x][y] != -1) return dp[t][x0][y0][x][y];
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
            int nx = x0 + dx[d];
            int ny = y0 + dy[d];
            if (nx < 0 || nx >= n || ny < 0 || ny >= n) continue;
            if (S[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Y' || S[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Z') continue;
            if (canReach(t + 1, nx, ny, x, y) == 1) {
                dp[t][x0][y0][x][y] = 1;
                return 1;
            }
        }
        dp[t][x0][y0][x][y] = 0;
        return 0;
    }

    void collect() {
        src = new ArrayList<>();
        snk = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = S[i].charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Z' && c != 'Y' && c != '0') src.add(new int[]{i, j});
            }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = T[i].charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Z' && c != 'Y' && c != '0') snk.add(new int[]{i, j});
            }
    }

    int run() {
        readInput();

        int zx = -1, zy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (T[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    zx = i;
                    zy = j;
                }

        bfsFromZ(zx, zy);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (distToZ[i][j] == -1) distToZ[i][j] = INF;

        collect();

        int S = 0;
        int TT = src.size() + snk.size() + 1;
        PushRelabelFIFO flow = new PushRelabelFIFO(TT + 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < src.size(); i++)
            flow.addEdge(S, i + 1, S[src.get(i)[0]].charAt(src.get(i)[1]) - '0');

        for (int i = 0; i < snk.size(); i++)
            flow.addEdge(src.size() + i + 1, TT,
                         T[snk.get(i)[0]].charAt(snk.get(i)[1]) - '0');

        for (int i = 0; i < src.size(); i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < snk.size(); j++)
                if (canReach(0, src.get(i)[0], src.get(i)[1],
                             snk.get(j)[0], snk.get(j)[1]) == 1)
                    flow.addEdge(i + 1, src.size() + j + 1, INF);

        return flow.maxFlow(S, TT);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Solver solver = new Solver();
        System.out.println(solver.run());
    }
}
